items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I don't know anything about it because when I was out in California I just got out of touch.

ctx.x: I recall reading somewhere that Thelma Carpenter was your replacement at the Onyx when you went out to the west coast. Do you remember anything about that?
There is a possibility that she did but I don't know anything about it because when I was out in California I just got out of touch.
